seo.title: Journal, lace, draping and pieces made to order | Awrea Paris
seo.description: The Awrea Paris Journal: the Hypnotic Lace collection, lace, draping and gilding, and how each piece is made to order by French artisans.

chapeau: Lace, draping, gilding, and the time it takes to make a piece to order. The Maison’s notebooks, left open.
